cohorts.label: All sessions
cohorts.note: Every complete session ever collected. Metrics that only exist in later builds are scored over the sessions that carry them, never imputed.

cohorts.label: Pilot era (pre-tag builds)
cohorts.note: Tactical agent in greedy mode: it suggested one task at a time, so tactical agreement here is agreement with a single step, not with a whole-mission plan.

cohorts.label: Study build (study-v1.0+)
cohorts.note: Tactical agent switched to plan-all (3-5 task plans) and the scenario set settled at v2.1. This is the first window where both tiers offer a comparable decision.

cohorts.label: Task outcomes logged (study-v1.2+)
cohorts.note: session_ended.taskOutcomes exists, so completion can be scored over the work the operator actually took on.

cohorts.label: Honest failure model (study-v1.4+)
cohorts.note: Drone failures fire at the intended rate on every machine. Before v1.4 a high-refresh display could meet no failures at all.

cohorts.label: Recovery Suggest works (study-v1.5+)
cohorts.note: The recovery planner’s Suggest button returns a plan instead of nothing, so agent use during a failure is measurable for the first time.
